newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - March 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - March 11.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Mobs kill a dozen people around Ivory Coast accusing them of being sorcerers who make sexual organs disappear, well-informed sources say; government launches investigation into origin of rumours that led to the panic and start campaign to persuade people that they are unfounded

- President Henri Konan Bedie pardons girl of 14 who was jailed one year ago for killing her husband after an arranged marriage - Experts examine ways of saving multinational carrier Air Afrique from being taxed in Italy; say convention states that it should only be taxed in Ivory Coast, country where it is based LA VOIE
- Liberalisation of fuel prices penalises motorists, newspaper investigation shows

- Ivory Coast pledges to cut its coffee production by 240,000 sacks as part of deal designed to boost world prices - Non-governmental organisation Our Nation calls for politicians to sign a charter to prevent conflict by committing them to avoid tribalisation of political debate
